cohort: The study included 1,016 Iranian children aged 6-12 years residing in Ilam City.
finding: The prevalence of MIH was 11% in the study population, with cesarean section, gestational diabetes, medication intake during pregnancy, genetics, newborn jaundice, respiratory problems, otitis, urinary tract infection, antibiotic therapy, and chickenpox significantly correlated with its occurrence.
mod_finding: Cesarean section had a positive association and was significantly correlated with the occurrence of MIH.
